# ex: ! pattern prevents further rewrites on matched node
ex {
	var x int
	x * 1 -> !
	x + 0 -> x
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	x := 1
	return x*1 + 0
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 func F() int {
 	x := 1
-	return x*1 + 0
+	return x * 1
 }
